introHtml: Polar Camel wine accessories bring the same double-wall vacuum insulation that keeps drinks cold for hours, now tailored for wine lovers. Whether you are outfitting a corporate wine tasting or gifting clients at a holiday party, these stainless steel tumblers and stemless glasses keep white wine chilled and red wine at the perfect temperature. Add your logo with full-color pad printing or etching for a polished, professional look that stands out on any table.
